column1: # How each path in felix-home is landed. Read by lib/land-table.sh.
# Columns, tab-separated: path, kind, trigger, arg. The kinds are engine
# constants and name no project:
#   version-above     the version goes above the base's and above every
#                     version installed in the plugin cache
#   keyed-union       the base's file plus the rows the branch added or
#                     changed, keyed on column <arg>
#   insertions-union  both sides, only when every conflict is two insertions
#                     that define no shell function or name in common
#   rerun             the base's side, then the command in <arg> is run
#   session           never mechanical: a session lands it
#   founder           a pull request touching it goes to the founder
# A trigger is - or a path; one ending in / names a directory. A row is owed
# when a landing touches its trigger and not its path. session and founder
# rows take an ERE path, no trigger and no arg. Only they may bind an escape,
# commission, authority, exception, workflow or trust-base path, or a land
# table itself, and a resolver on a path one of them matches is refused.
# Read only from refs/remotes/origin/main, never the working tree: a pull
# request cannot rewrite the recipe that lands it. Every change to a row here
# escapes to the founder, additions, reorders and a changed byte included;
# comments are free. That holds once an engine listing land.tsv judges: the
# pull request that adds this file is carried to the founder by hand. The rows
# are shown to the founder verbatim at the arming sitting. Until then they do
# nothing unattended: owed and behind only write would-refuse rows to says.log.
